lines.text: Christmas Eve charades, for every age. A hundred and twenty cards, in three levels. The kids act out building a snowman. The grown-ups get the Secret Santa reveal. Or flip to Draw It mode. Sixteen pages. Instant download. Tap the link, and grab it on Etsy.

A real letter from Santa, by Christmas Eve. Six letters, for six kinds of year. Type their name, and three good things they did. Add the Nice List certificate. And twelve gift tags from Santa. Thirteen pages. Instant download. Tap the link, and grab it on Etsy.
